def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) 
  (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) 
  (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  if n == 0 then
    zero
  else
    let rest : ℕ := n >> 1
    let b : Bool := n % 2 == 1
    bit b rest (VTask.binaryRec zero bit rest)
